books.name: Principles of Cantrip Craft
books.description: A primer on shaping minor magic without burning out a novice's focus.
books.passive: After 1 hour of study during a Short Rest, gain a +1 bonus to your next Intelligence (Arcana) check about cantrips.

books.name: Stellar Omens & Night Signs
books.description: Charts constellations said to foretell wars, harvests, and royal successions.
books.passive: If you study this book under an open sky at night, you have advantage on your next Wisdom (Survival) check made to navigate by the stars.

books.name: The Ember Codex
books.description: Forbidden notes on fire runes copied from a salvaged tower library.
books.passive: After studying for 1 hour, you have advantage on your next check to identify fire runes, warm magic, or scorch marks.

books.name: Wards for the Wary
books.description: Household protective circles explained for shopkeepers and sailors.
books.passive: After studying, gain a +1 bonus to your next Intelligence (Investigation) check to find a hidden trap or hazard indoors.

books.name: Whisper-Tongue Grammars
books.description: Studies the dead languages used to bargain with fey envoys.
books.passive: After 1 hour of study, gain a +1 bonus to your next Charisma check made to parley with fey or undead.

books.name: Clockwork & Counterweights
books.description: Illustrated treatise on gears, springs, and town clock repair.
books.passive: Gain a +1 bonus to your next Intelligence (Investigation) check involving locks, gears, or clockwork mechanisms.

books.name: On the Weight of Air
books.description: Early natural philosophy arguing that wind is matter in motion.
books.passive: You have advantage on your next check to predict wind, weather, or drafts within the next 24 hours.

books.name: Salt, Sulfur, and Smoke
books.description: Field notes on smelting, glassblowing, and kiln temperatures.
books.passive: Gain a +1 bonus to your next check using smith's tools, glassblower's tools, or when judging kiln heat.

books.name: The Moving Heavens
books.description: Controversial models of planets, moons, and tidal pull.
books.passive: Gain a +1 bonus to your next Intelligence (Arcana) or (Nature) check about moons, tides, or planetary motion.

books.name: Vitals & Humors
books.description: A physician's guide to pulse, fever, and sensible bleeding.
books.passive: After studying, gain a +1 bonus to your next Wisdom (Medicine) check.

books.name: Chronicle of the First Kings
books.description: Royal lineages from mythic founders to the present court.
books.passive: You have advantage on your next Intelligence (History) check about royalty, succession, or court titles in this region.

books.name: Flood Years of the Low Town
books.description: Survivor accounts of the great river rise and rebuilding.
books.passive: You have advantage on your next Wisdom (Survival) check to find safe footing or shelter in flooded or marshy terrain.

books.name: Guild Charters of Old
books.description: Copied statutes governing smiths, weavers, and river pilots.
books.passive: Gain a +1 bonus to your next Charisma (Persuasion) check with guild artisans, pilots, or trade officials.

books.name: Siege of the Grey Gate
books.description: Battle maps and testimony from a decade-long border war.
books.passive: You have advantage on your next Intelligence (History) check about sieges, fortifications, or siege engines.

books.name: Trade Roads & Toll Stones
books.description: Merchant routes, caravan fees, and safe harbors.
books.passive: Gain a +1 bonus to your next Wisdom (Survival) check to avoid getting lost on a road, trail, or caravan route.

books.name: Hymns for Harvest Eve
books.description: Seasonal songs and rites for rural temples.
books.passive: After reciting one hymn aloud, gain a +1 bonus to your next Charisma (Performance) check.

books.name: Lives of the Lantern Saints
books.description: Hagiographies of healers who walked with a single flame.
books.passive: You have advantage on your next Wisdom (Religion) check about local saints, shrines, or healing rites.

books.name: Pilgrim Paths East
books.description: Shrines, hostels, and relic customs along a sacred road.
books.passive: Gain a +1 bonus to your next Wisdom (Survival) check while traveling a marked pilgrim route or holy road.

books.name: The Book of Small Mercies
books.description: Prayers for travelers, midwives, and grieving households.
books.passive: When you comfort a frightened or grieving creature for 1 minute, it gains a +1 bonus on its next saving throw against being frightened (once).

books.name: Treatise on Sacred Oaths
books.description: When a vow binds the soul—and when it may be broken.
books.passive: You have advantage on your next Wisdom (Insight) check to tell whether someone is honoring or breaking a sworn vow.

books.name: Beasts of the Fen
books.description: Sketches and habits of eels, herons, and marsh cats.
books.passive: You have advantage on your next Wisdom (Nature) check to identify marsh beasts or their tracks.

books.name: Forest Cant & Herb Lore
books.description: Which leaves soothe fever and which berries kill.
books.passive: Gain a +1 bonus to your next Intelligence (Nature) check to identify common herbs, berries, or edible plants.

books.name: Mountain Stone & Root
books.description: Geology and foraging among high passes and scree fields.
books.passive: You have advantage on your next Wisdom (Survival) check foraging in hills, mountains, or rocky highlands.

books.name: Seasons of the Wheat Belt
books.description: Planting calendars tied to river thaw and crow migration.
books.passive: Gain a +1 bonus to your next Wisdom (Survival) or Intelligence (Nature) check about crops, harvest timing, or farmland.

books.name: Whale Roads
books.description: Sailor charts of migration lanes along cold coasts.
books.passive: You have advantage on your next Wisdom (Survival) or navigator's tools check on open water or along a coast.

books.name: A Bestiary for Bailiffs
books.description: Common monsters likely to raid barns and toll roads.
books.passive: You have advantage on your next Intelligence check to recall the habits of predators or pests near settlements.

books.name: Dragons: A Cautious Survey
books.description: Scholarly skepticism about scale, hoards, and flame.
books.passive: Gain a +1 bonus to your next Intelligence (Arcana) or (Nature) check about dragons, wyrmlings, or dragon lairs.

books.name: Goblin Customs & Taboos
books.description: Observations from a truce envoy who returned alive.
books.passive: You have advantage on your next Charisma check when parleying with goblins, hobgoblins, or bugbears.

books.name: Owlbear Nesting Notes
books.description: Where not to camp, according to rangers.
books.passive: Gain a +1 bonus to your next Wisdom (Perception) check to spot owlbear sign, feathers, or nesting grounds.

books.name: Trolls Under the Bridge
books.description: Folklore cross-checked with toll-keeper interviews.
books.passive: You have advantage on your next Intelligence (Investigation) check near bridges, fords, or toll crossings.

books.name: Antidotes & Neutral Salts
books.description: Recipes for venom counters and sting poultices.
books.passive: Gain a +1 bonus to your next Wisdom (Medicine) check to treat poison, venom, or toxic stings.

books.name: Distillation for Beginners
books.description: Safe glasswork and flame control for apothecaries.
books.passive: You have advantage on your next check using alchemist's supplies or brewer's supplies for a mundane brew.

books.name: Elixirs of Wakefulness
books.description: Stimulant tonics popular with watch captains.
books.passive: For the next 4 hours, you have advantage on Constitution saving throws against exhaustion caused by lack of sleep (once per long rest).

books.name: Ink of Binding
books.description: Arcane formulae for contracts that resist forgery.
books.passive: Gain a +1 bonus to your next Intelligence (Investigation) check to spot forged signatures, seals, or contract clauses.

books.name: Pigments & Preservatives
books.description: How to keep maps and scrolls from mildew.
books.passive: You have advantage on your next check to preserve maps, books, or documents from mildew, smearing, or water damage.

books.name: Bailiff's Field Manual
books.description: Arrest, holding, and fair notice in market towns.
books.passive: Gain a +1 bonus to your next Charisma (Intimidation or Persuasion) check when acting as an agent of the law.

books.name: Charter of the Free Bridge
books.description: River crossing rights fought over for three generations.
books.passive: You have advantage on your next check to negotiate tolls, tariffs, or river crossing fees.

books.name: Inheritance in Ten Tables
books.description: Who inherits a shop when siblings disagree.
books.passive: Gain a +1 bonus to your next Intelligence (Investigation) check involving wills, deeds, or inheritance disputes.

books.name: Market Measures & Penalties
books.description: Weights, false scales, and public shaming fines.
books.passive: You have advantage on your next Wisdom (Perception) check to spot false scales, short measure, or rigged weights.

books.name: Oaths Before the Magistrate
books.description: Recorded speeches from famous trials.
books.passive: You have advantage on your next Charisma (Persuasion) check before a judge, magistrate, or court official.

books.name: Ballads of the Lost Company
books.description: Soldier songs from a company that never returned.
books.passive: Gain a +1 bonus to your next Charisma (Performance) check when singing or reciting soldier ballads.

books.name: Elegies for River Towns
books.description: Mourning verse after floods and failed harvests.
books.passive: After reading an elegy aloud for 1 minute, one ally who listens gains a +1 bonus on their next saving throw against fear.

books.name: Love Letters Never Sent
books.description: Romantic poems copied from a sealed estate chest.
books.passive: Gain a +1 bonus to your next Charisma (Persuasion) check in a romantic or heartfelt conversation.

books.name: Songs the Gulls Know
books.description: Harbor poetry in salt-stained chapbook form.
books.passive: You have advantage on your next Charisma (Performance) check performed in a harbor, port, or dockside tavern.

books.name: The Green Knight's Lay
books.description: Chivalric romance in uneven rhyme.
books.passive: Gain a +1 bonus to your next Charisma (Performance) or (Persuasion) check involving chivalric etiquette or courtly manners.

books.name: Cave Maps of the Red Hills
books.description: Survey sketches sold without guarantee of return.
books.passive: You have advantage on your next Wisdom (Survival) check to avoid getting lost in caves or red-rock badlands.

books.name: Dungeon Delver's Checklist
books.description: Rope lengths, chalk marks, and retreat signals.
books.passive: Gain a +1 bonus to your next Wisdom (Perception) check to spot traps, loose stone, or unsafe footing underground.

books.name: Mercenary Contracts Explained
books.description: What a company owes you when the lord defaults.
books.passive: You have advantage on your next Intelligence (Investigation) check to read contracts, pay clauses, or mercenary terms.

books.name: Sailor's Storm Almanac
books.description: Weather signs trusted on long blue-water runs.
books.passive: You have advantage on your next Wisdom (Survival) check to predict an imminent storm at sea or on the coast.

books.name: The Squire's First Tour
books.description: Practical advice for youths joining a road company.
books.passive: Gain a +1 bonus to your next Wisdom (Animal Handling) or Charisma check when dealing with mounts, camp followers, or road crews.
